final: WITH regional AS (SELECT d.A3 AS region, AVG(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN 0 - t.amount ELSE NULL END) AS avg_signed_amount, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM trans AS t JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id WHERE t.date > '1996-05-09' AND t.date < '1998-01-06' GROUP BY d.A3), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_signed_amount) AS avg_regional_amount FROM regional) SELECT regional.region, regional.avg_signed_amount, regional.record_count, regional.avg_signed_amount / NULLIF(overall.avg_regional_amount, 0) FROM regional CROSS JOIN overall WHERE overall.avg_regional_amount IS NOT NULL
